How one phone call shows the power of connections.

Kevin Trudeau tells it as a scene. He is in a car in Puerto Rico with Danielle beside him when the phone rings. On the line is a famous multi-billionaire asking for his advice.

Kevin explains that moments like this come from meeting the right people, and that when you have those connections, everything is different.

Who in your life makes you think bigger?
